text:
Ivy: Heads-up: Prospect (AtlasPay POC) started getting intermittent 5xxs during an internal load test at ~09:12PT. They changed their client to send large batches (batch_size=64) + aggressive retry policy and then saw spike -> errors. Sales flagged; CISO wants RCA and mitigation.

Priya: What error codes & model? Any request IDs?

Ivy: Mostly 500 and 502. Model: r-instruct-large-v1. Sample req ids: 3c9d8a1b, 7f2b44e0. Traffic pattern: bursts of 200-350 rps but each request contains large batch=64 so worker CPU / mem per-request shot up.

Ken: Pulling traces now. Interesting pattern: frontdoor queues are OK, but once requests hit workers we see long GC pauses and a handful of containers hitting RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (kernel mem pressure) and restarting. Workers returning 500 before model response. Also saw retry amplification: client retried synchronously on backend errors which multiplied load.

Maya: That combination is bad: large client-side batch + aggressive retry -> amplification + KV cache thrash on workers (cache eviction spike). Long-tail cold-starts when a restarted container reloads the quant kernels.

deploy-bot: autoscaler: scale request accepted for atlas-poc-pool at 09:13:05; +4 pods requested.

Priya: Short-term actions: (1) apply per-tenant concurrency cap (max_concurrent=20), (2) force tenant max_batch=8, (3) add upstream header advising clients to disable retries on server errors (X-Redwood-Suppress-Retries: 1). Also recommend enabling tenant fallback to r-instruct-medium-quant if queue_threshold exceeded.

deploy-bot: apply: tenant(atlaspay).max_concurrent=20 -> accepted
deploy-bot: apply: tenant(atlaspay).max_batch=8 -> accepted
deploy-bot: apply: tenant(atlaspay).fallback=r-instruct-medium-quant -> accepted

Ken: I uploaded a diagnostic bundle: https://redwood-internal/diag/2834567890 - includes frontdoor spans, worker logs, restart traces, and heap profiles. Note: AtlasPay asked that the diag bundle be encrypted at rest due to PII in prompts; security confirmed we used tenant-specific KMS key.

security-bot: Confirmed: diag bundle encrypted with tenant KMS key. Default audit bundles redact prompts, but customer requested encrypted raw bundle for forensic review; access logged and requires security approval.

Ivy: Sales: cost and options? They asked if a warm pool helps here.

Priya: Warm pool reduces cold-starts after restarts but doesn't prevent memory pressure from huge per-request batches. Short-term for demo: keep max_batch=8 + concurrency cap + suppress retries. Warm pool optional but helpful; estimate: 1 GPU prewarm ~$0.60/hr. For contract-level guarantees recommend Dedicated with reserved warm pools and higher concurrency limits.

sales-bot: Customer wants a one-line they can give auditors: "We ran mitigations and will run a practice replay." Can we provide that?

Priya: Draft: "We applied per-tenant concurrency limits, reduced max batch size, enabled an automated fallback to a lower-memory model, and encrypted diagnostic artifacts. We also recommend a 2-minute practice replay at demo time. For contractual SLAs, consider Dedicated deployment with reserved warm pools."

Maya: Client-side snippet to avoid amplification:

POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN
X-Redwood-Suppress-Retries: 1
{
  "model": "r-instruct-large-v1",
  "batch_size": 8,
  "max_tokens": 128
}

Include client retry: 2 attempts max, jittered, and only on connection errors (not on 5xx).

Ken: After changes we see worker restarts reduced and 5xx rate dropped from ~15% -> 1.1% over 10m. Some pods still warming; watching heap profiles.

Ivy: CISO asked if prompts are persisted in logs by default. What's the answer?

security-bot: Default: operational logs (stack traces, timings) do not store prompt content. Audit/diagnostic bundles redact prompts unless customer requests unredacted and signs a limited-access request. We captured an encrypted unredacted bundle per AtlasPay request with access audit trail.

Priya: Follow-ups: ops to keep these tenant caps for 12h and then review; eng-runtime to consider guardrail that rejects batches above a safe per-tenant threshold with clearer error. I'll open a ticket.

Ivy: Thanks team. Sales: I've sent the draft note and diag link to the customer and scheduled a practice replay at demo time. Will escalate if anything else pops.
